title: Minimum opening.
officialText: The minimum openable area to the outdoors shall be 5 percent of the floor area of the space being ventilated. Every window or skylight providing required natural ventilation shall be at least 3 square feet (0.28 m2) providing a minimum of 1½ square feet (0.14 m2) of openable area.
